comment: EPO03 accepted atlas regions for team west, in blit order. A region appears here ONLY after the single-defect loop ACCEPT (generate -> composite -> guards -> full atlas + x2 perimeter + 197x426 phone FOV -> verdict). Fields: id, x, y, w, h (crop origin/size on the 1024^2 atlas; <id>.png and <id>_mask.png are exactly w x h), salt (>= 40, unique across all five manifests), status, job, seed, atlas, review, team, reauthorizes (landmark golden ids this region overwrites; each is re-extracted in the same commit — DECISIONS/0033).

regions.name: core_face_upper
regions.intent: The core forest's west face above the road (the vertical wall at x~256, y 300-494, inside the A-4 rim FMPO02 could not write) breaks westward into bays, promontories and stepping copses that meet W1's meadow copses; firs at the top, oaks below; the wood east of x 296 stays unbroken for the fairy glade; Greenwatch (286,431) keeps a forest edge.
